stage.name: Muted Past
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

flying_boots_elite_mercenary.name: 'Flying Boots' Elite Mercenary
flying_boots_elite_mercenary.flavourText: Mercenaries propelled by compressed air cans beneath their feet. Their favorite targets are Ursus convoys and their simple, durable Ursine products.
abilities: Capable of evading physical attacks. Loses Physical Dodge against a Stabilizer Chain.

mechanic.name: 'Mechanic'
mechanic.flavourText: Sarkaz artificers who have finally invented a working flying machine, perhaps the predecessor to far more powerful war machines in the distant future.
abilities: Low-Altitude Hovering
Attack range reduced when it loses Low-Altitude Hovering.

rogue_mercenary_lead_guitar.name: Rogue Mercenary 'Lead Guitar'
rogue_mercenary_lead_guitar.flavourText: Metal band members who seamlessly blend their mercenary and performer careers. Their torrential rhythms are powerful enough to melt faces—literally.
abilities: Targets one of your units, continuously dealing Arts and Burn to the target and all Operators connected to that unit by Stabilizer Chains.

sarkaz_lancer.name: Sarkaz Lancer
sarkaz_lancer.flavourText: A Sarkaz mercenary. After special training, they are capable of rushing forward with a long spear, building up speed. The faster they charge, the harder they strike anyone who might stand in their way.
abilities: Gradually accelerates when moving, and deals additional damage on the first attack after being blocked based upon Movement Speed.

bounty_hunter_grand_knight.name: Bounty Hunter 'Grand Knight'
bounty_hunter_grand_knight.flavourText: Bounty hunters skilled in witchcraft, aspiring to join the Kazimierzian knight competitions once they've saved enough money. For now, their greatest joy remains tormenting their targets as they hunt them down.
abilities: Accelerates when moving. First attack after being blocked deals extra Arts damage based on movement speed.

sarkaz_lancer_leader.name: Sarkaz Lancer Leader
sarkaz_lancer_leader.flavourText: A Sarkaz, more threatening than a normal Sarkaz Lancer. After special training, they are capable of rushing forward with a long spear, building up speed. The faster they charge, the harder they strike anyone who might stand in their way.
abilities: Gradually accelerates when moving, and deals additional damage on the first attack after being blocked based upon Movement Speed.

seed_of_decay.name: Seed of Decay
seed_of_decay.flavourText: Originium Arts creation of the Nachzehrer King. It is a violation of the laws of nature, rejecting life for death. They create death for others to feed upon.
abilities: Flying unit.
Self-destructs when near an Operator, dealing Physical damage

londinium_precision_mobile_defense_artil.name: Londinium Precision Mobile Defense Artillery
londinium_precision_mobile_defense_artil.flavourText: Part of Londinium's city defenses. Has a very large attack area and greatly improved accuracy. Built by the city's workers in their factories.
abilities: Capable of long-range attacks
Locks on to the target with the highest max HP and bombards it several times, dealing Arts damage to the unit in range with the highest HP percentage

decaying_collector_disciple.name: Decaying Collector Disciple
decaying_collector_disciple.flavourText: An organic construct containing the Nachzehrer King's Originium Arts. It can extract all kinds of dead souls from the battlefield to create Seeds of Decay.
abilities: Flying unit.
Periodically summons several <Seeds of Decay>

gopnik.name: Gopnik
gopnik.flavourText: The Ursus security guard hired by Duck Lord. Powerful, but not very smart. Mainly responsible for carrying luggage for Duck Lord.

crying_thief.name: Crying Thief
crying_thief.flavourText: A Perro who left his family to seek out a new life... but all that people know is that he is always weeping.
abilities: Invisible
Attacks Stun the target

duck_lord.name: Duck Lord
duck_lord.flavourText: A famous Columbian investor, entrepreneur, and master of 'Duck Power.' Out of the public eye, enjoys kicking back with others...
abilities: Cannot be blocked.
Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after being attacked

fatty.name: Fatty
fatty.flavourText: Duck Lord's associate and apprentice, an opportunist with a slick tongue. Frequently appears on dubious TV shows, preaching about how he cares little for losses or gains, as they are part of the natural money-making process.
abilities: Always faces the direction with the most Operators.
Takes 80% less Physical/Arts damage from the front.

little_bajie.name: Little Ba'jie
little_bajie.flavourText: A mascot for the Garden of Grotesqueries that Yi made himself, transformed into a geist from the adoration of visitors. One of the few geists not under the supervision of the Sui Regulator or Tianshi Bureaus. It spends its days interacting with visitors at the souvenir shop, or playing with ritual processions on the days when the garden is closed.
abilities: Low-Altitude Hovering
After receiving a certain number of hits, deals Arts damage to all allied units in a large area and stuns them

body_of_sui.name: 'Body of Sui'
body_of_sui.flavourText: Formed from ink and sculptures, It hides in the clouds, waiting for the opportunity to extinguish the candle of mankind.
abilities: Does not normally exist on the battlefield; locks on to your unit with the most nearby units, triggering [Sleepless]
[Sleepless] Forces the target and Operators in the 8 surrounding tiles to retreat, temporarily creating undeployable for a while
Triggers [Sleepless] and stays on the battlefield for a while before leaving without draining Life Points

emergency.condition: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and Weight and greatly increased HP; additional enemies will appear; additional Statuegeists will appear
